targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_eval")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "metric_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "${task}" and r.W == "${W}" and r.drift == "${drift}")
  |> group(columns: ["model", "variant", "metric_name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 100s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_eval")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "t_encode" or r._field == "t_fit" or r._field == "t_predict")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "${task}" and r.W == "${W}")
  |> group(columns: ["model", "_field"])
  |> mean()

panels.title: Quantum Circuit Executions per Step (E1 Cache Effect)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_eval")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.family == "quantum" and r._field == "n_circuit_evals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "${task}")
  |> group(columns: ["model", "variant", "W"])

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_eval")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency")
  |> group(columns: ["task", "model", "family"])
